DIV8.HEAD: § 1231.1 Scope.
DIV8.P: This part establishes a consumer product safety standard for high chairs.

DIV8.HEAD: § 1231.2 Requirements for high chairs.
DIV8.P: Each high chair shall comply with all applicable provisions of ASTM F404-21, Standard Consumer Safety Specification for High Chairs, approved on November 15, 2021. The Director of the Federal Register approves this incorporation by reference in accordance with 5 U.S.C. 552(a) and 1 CFR part 51. A read-only copy of the standard is available for viewing on the ASTM website at https://www.astm.org/READINGLIBRARY/. You may obtain a copy from ASTM International, 100 Barr Harbor Drive, PO Box C700, West Conshohocken, PA 19428-2959; telephone (610) 832-9585; www.astm.org.
